```{r setup}
library(pwb)
```

```{r}
nsims <- 1e5
ma.results2 <- simMeta(N=233, theta=0.8, n.studies=4, nsims=nsims)
wtdmeans.ex2 <- rep(NA, nsims)
for(i in 1:nsims)    wtdmeans.ex2[i] <- weighted.mean(x=ma.results2$theta.hat[i, ], w=1/ma.results2$se[i, ]^2)
mean(wtdmeans.ex2)-0.8


nsims <- 1e5
theta.vec <- seq(from=0.1, to=0.9, by=0.1)
bias.vec <- numeric(length(theta.vec))

for(i in 1:length(theta.vec)){
  ma <- simMeta(N=233, theta=theta.vec[i], n.studies=4, nsims=nsims)
  wtd.means <- rep(NA, nsims)
  for(j in 1:nsims)    wtd.means[j] <- weighted.mean(x=ma$theta.hat[j, ], w=1/ma$se[j, ]^2)
  bias.vec[i] <- mean(wtd.means)-theta.vec[i]
}
plot(x=theta.vec, y=bias.vec, xlab="theta", ylab="Bias (estimate - theta)", xlim=c(0.05, 0.95), ylim=c(-0.005, 0.005), xaxt="n", main = "Meta-analysis, n.studies=4, Ni=233")
abline(h=0, lty=2)
axis(1, at = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1))

mean(bias.vec)


require(xtable)

mdat <- matrix(c(rep(0,3), 0, 5, 0, rep(0, (7*3)), 0, 5, 0),
               nrow = 10, ncol=3, byrow=TRUE)
xtable(df,digits=mdat)
```
